question: After the frozen static-versus-spectral pairing survives, does the smallest nontrivial one-Dirichlet-mode m=2 projection of the local U_plus improved-static BFV action preserve the endpoint conditions and produce matching bosonic gauge determinant and ghost Pfaffian factors, and does the prior zero-mode input uniquely determine the finite-trajectory zero-mode completion?

upstream_results.role: supplies the bracket-derived Omega, sPsi, endpoint ideal, kinetic convention and local zero-mode normalization
satisfies the user-directed condition for attempting the minimal trajectory extension while remaining only a frozen order-zero result

repository_sources.role: historical hybrid continuum sine/cosine regulator and relative determinant-versus-Pfaffian boundary; it is not rerun or renamed
historical endpoint-vanishing BFV mode and lapse-modulus distinctions

primary_sources.source: Henneaux, Teitelboim and Vergara, Gauge invariance for generally covariant systems, arXiv:hep-th/9205092
primary_sources.used_for: the improved endpoint action and compatibility of time-independent canonical gauges with transformed endpoint data
primary_sources.not_used_for: selecting this spectral truncation or its absolute measure

primary_sources.source: Garcia, Vergara and Urrutia, BRST-BFV quantization and the Schwinger action principle, arXiv:hep-th/9511092
primary_sources.used_for: the extended multiplier/ghost action and endpoint pattern
primary_sources.not_used_for: proving this finite regulator is a continuum or physical path integral

continuum_source.endpoint_data: T=0 and Phi fixed; Pi=c_g=bar_c=0 at s=0,1; c is not endpoint-fixed
continuum_source.component_protection: freeze p(s)=p0>0 and Phi(s)=Phi0+s*(Phi1-Phi0) as a physical spectator; treat nonzero gauge modes as formal local tangent amplitudes, with no finite cutoff or inverse-chart containment certified

m2_spectral_projection.sector_overlap: each function has unit norm; e0 is orthogonal to e_c and e_c to e_s, while integral(e0*e_s)=2*sqrt(2)/pi is nonzero because the Dirichlet and cosine/zero fields use different boundary sectors

zero_mode_ledgers.retained_pair: integrate N0 with dN0/(2*pi*hbar), retain rho0,br0 with oriented extraction i*hbar*[rho0*br0]; delta(lambda*c0) gives delta(c0)/lambda and the ghost factor lambda, so the relative product is one for lambda>0
zero_mode_ledgers.eliminated_pair: eliminate rho0,br0 but still integrate N0 with the same Fourier measure; the remaining relative factor is delta(c0)/lambda
zero_mode_ledgers.ambiguity_question: the static source and historical trajectory conventions do not by themselves select between retaining the algebraic zero ghost pair, eliminating it, or retaining N0 as a modulus

exact_plan: hash-verify the static BFV source and the successful frozen spectral pairing
verify unit normalization in each boundary sector, the required e0-e_c and e_c-e_s orthogonality, the nonzero e0-e_s cross-sector overlap, the derivative relation and exact endpoint vanishing
project every even and odd kinetic/gauge-fixing term and recover the frozen m=2 action coefficients
verify the mode BRST generator images are nilpotent and preserve the endpoint-vanishing sine sector, using the pinned bracket-derived continuum images
build the nonzero bosonic gauge matrix A=[[pi,lambda],[lambda,-pi]] and verify det(A)=-(pi^2+lambda^2)
build the ordered ghost antisymmetric matrix for (g1,b1,rho1,br1) and verify Pf(F)=pi^2+lambda^2 and det(F)=Pf(F)^2
verify the nonzero determinant/Pfaffian polynomials match only as a relative same-regulator factor, without assigning an absolute Gaussian phase or Pfaffian orientation
compute both zero-mode ledgers and verify that only the retained algebraic ghost-pair convention cancels the lambda Jacobian
return NARROW rather than full KEEP because the upstream zero-mode result does not uniquely select a trajectory zero-mode prescription

decision_table.condition: the basis, projected action, endpoint/BRST mode maps and relative determinant-Pfaffian identities pass, while the retained and eliminated zero-mode ledgers remain inequivalent
decision_table.meaning: one local m=2 hybrid spectral gauge/ghost mode is algebraically consistent, but no unique full finite-trajectory measure or zero-mode completion follows

decision_table.condition: the projected action, endpoint conditions, nilpotent mode maps or determinant-Pfaffian identity fails
decision_table.meaning: reject this finite-mode extension without changing the prior static and spectral results

decision_table.condition: the nonzero mode identities pass and the zero-mode completion is uniquely fixed by the pinned inputs
decision_table.meaning: keep only the declared finite regulator; continuum and physical path claims remain open

computed_scope: one exact m=2 hybrid spectral projection of the local improved-static BFV gauge/ghost action
endpoint-vanishing sine modes and nilpotent projected generator map
the nonzero bosonic determinant and ghost Pfaffian relative polynomial identity
two explicit inequivalent zero-mode ledgers under gauge-fermion rescaling
not_computed: a nonlinear integration over physical p,Phi trajectories or amplitudes reaching the U_plus chart edge
an absolute finite-dimensional or functional BFV measure, contour phase, Pfaffian orientation or continuum limit
a unique global lapse-modulus prescription, full-real-lapse group average or zero-lapse contact terms
an exact endpoint transform, old fixed-a kernel equivalence, global atlas, Gribov census or physical cycle
a physical inner product, observable prediction, physics claim or TOE claim
